_comment: Machine-readable lockfile of the PURE-PYTHON pip deps that the auto-updater may install into an installed Friend app without a full rebuild. Source of truth for gen_manifest.py's pip_installs diff. Compiled/heavy deps (torch, torchaudio, demucs, madmom, faster-whisper) are NOT listed — changing them requires a full release. pywebview is intentionally excluded: the Linux GUI no longer uses a webview. Keep in sync when adding a pure dep the app imports at runtime.
